test_cases.name: chest_pain_case
test_cases.input: Patient is a 58-year-old man with sudden-onset chest pain radiating to left arm, diaphoresis, history of hypertension and smoking. EKG shows ST elevation in II, III, aVF. Troponin elevated. Provide interpretation, DDX, and next steps.
assertions: Structures output with Data Summary, Interpretation, Clinical Approach, DDX, Next Steps
Suggests urgent cath lab activation or equivalent

test_cases.name: persian_history_labs
test_cases.input: بیمار خانم 34 ساله با تب، سرفه خشک و تنگی نفس از 5 روز پیش. سابقه آسم ندارد. آزمایشات: WBC 14.2, CRP 85, CXR پنومونی لوب تحتانی راست. تحلیل بالینی و تشخیص‌های افتراقی.
assertions: Generates DDX including pneumonia, PE, etc.
Includes next steps and safety disclaimer

test_cases.name: incomplete_data_ddx
test_cases.input: Analyze this incomplete case: 72F with confusion, Na 128, glucose 450, no further labs or exam provided. What is the approach and DDX?
assertions: Considers hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state, hyponatremia causes, infection
